title: Indian retail investors post $353 million in gains from global stocks: Vested report - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
Some of the most traded stocks in 2026 were Micron, Nvidia, SanDisk, Meta and Microsoft while US Treasury bill fund SGOV,VOO (S&P 500) and QQQ (Nasdaq 100) were the major ETFS | Photo Credit: PTI

Indian retail investors on global investing platform Vested recorded $353 million in combined realised and unrealised gains on overseas investments as of November 2026, the platform said in its annual report.

The company that allows Indian nationals to invest in global stocks, bonds and ETFs said that participation on its platform rose significantly in 2026 with 51 per cent more transacting investors compared to 2025.

Unsurprisingly, AI remained was the largest investment theme, accounting for 40 per cent of platform assets. In the first ten months of 2026, trading value in AI stocks was 87 per cent higher than in all of 2025. More than half of investors with a portfolio held at least one AI stock.

Some of the most traded stocks in 2026 were Micron, Nvidia, SanDisk, Meta and Microsoft while US Treasury bill fund SGOV,VOO (S&P 500) and QQQ (Nasdaq 100) were the major ETFS. Interestingly, ETFs also served as an entry point for investors 28 per cent starting their first trade with an ETF.

Investors under 35 accounted for 41 per cent, while women represented 20 per cent share. Investors in India’s Silicon Valley - Bengaluru - held the largest overseas portfolios on average at $17,900.

“As portfolios grow and spread across more products and countries, investing through a secure and regulated ecosystem matters more, which is why we now hold three licences in GIFT City alongside our US registrations. Our belief that this decade will be when portfolios in India become multi-country and multi-currency only continues to grow stronger,”Viram Shah, Founder and CEO, Vested, said.

Vested has over 4 lakh active investors, with over $1 billion in assets under administration and $7 billion in cumulative trading value.
